mentions.name: Predictable
mentions.description: A personal finance app that evens out irregular income and expenses into a constant weekly flow of cash by buffering: users specify income and expense schedules (weekly, monthly, semi-monthly, and other intervals), and overflow or underflow goes to a 'margin' bucket that shows how much can be spent right now while still covering recurring expenses. Currently built for the author's own use.
mentions.problem: Personal money arrives and goes out on chaotic, irregular schedules, making it hard to know how much is safe to spend while keeping up with recurring expenses.
mentions.source_excerpt: A personal finance app called “Predictable” that takes chaotic sloshes of money and turns them into steady streams of cash. You tell it “I receive this much money weekly/monthly/on the first and fifteenth/when Mercury is in retrograde, and I have these expenses at other various intervals” and it evens everything out into a constant weekly flow of cash by, essentially, buffering.
